cart_lines_fragrance_ids_check.name: cart_lines_fragrance_ids_check
cart_lines_fragrance_ids_check.value: "cart_lines"."fragrance_ids" is null or (cardinality("cart_lines"."fragrance_ids") = 5 and array_position("cart_lines"."fragrance_ids", null) is null)

cart_lines_kind_check.name: cart_lines_kind_check
cart_lines_kind_check.value:
(kind = 'volume' and volume_id is not null and fragrance_ids is null)
        or (kind = 'discovery_set' and volume_id is null and fragrance_ids is null)
        or (kind = 'builder_set' and volume_id is null and cardinality(fragrance_ids) = 5)

generated.as: case when amount_tiyin % 100 = 0 then amount_tiyin / 100 end

credits_not_for_order.name: credits_not_for_order
credits_not_for_order.value: ("credits"."not_for_order_at" is null) = ("credits"."not_for_order_by" is null) and ("credits"."not_for_order_note" is null or "credits"."not_for_order_at" is not null)

order_lines_kind_check.name: order_lines_kind_check
order_lines_kind_check.value: ("order_lines"."kind"::text = 'volume' and "order_lines"."volume_id" is not null and "order_lines"."set_volume_ids" is null) or ("order_lines"."kind"::text = 'builder_set' and "order_lines"."volume_id" is null and cardinality("order_lines"."set_volume_ids") = 5 and jsonb_array_length("order_lines"."set_composition") = 5) or ("order_lines"."kind"::text = 'discovery_set' and "order_lines"."volume_id" is null and "order_lines"."set_volume_ids" is null and jsonb_array_length("order_lines"."set_composition") = 5)

orders_point_or_typed.name: orders_point_or_typed
orders_point_or_typed.value: ("orders"."typed_address" is null and "orders"."point_code" is not null and "orders"."point_name" is not null and "orders"."point_city" is not null and "orders"."point_address" is not null) or ("orders"."typed_address" is not null and "orders"."bts_point_id" is null and "orders"."point_code" is null and "orders"."point_name" is null and "orders"."point_city" is null and "orders"."point_address" is null and "orders"."point_landmark" is null and "orders"."point_hours" is null)

orders_money.name: orders_money
orders_money.value: "orders"."items_subtotal" >= 0 and "orders"."discount_amount" >= 0 and "orders"."delivery_fee" >= 0 and "orders"."threshold_base_amount" >= 0 and "orders"."total" >= 0 and "orders"."amount_due" >= 0 and "orders"."amount_due" <= "orders"."total"

outbox_pending_idx.name: outbox_pending_idx
outbox_pending_idx.where: sent_at is null and failed_at is null

promo_codes_terms_check.name: promo_codes_terms_check
promo_codes_terms_check.value: ("promo_codes"."kind" = 'percent' and "promo_codes"."percent" between 1 and 100 and "promo_codes"."amount" is null) or ("promo_codes"."kind" = 'fixed' and "promo_codes"."amount" > 0 and "promo_codes"."percent" is null and "promo_codes"."max_discount" is null) or ("promo_codes"."kind"::text = 'gift' and "promo_codes"."percent" is null and "promo_codes"."amount" is null and "promo_codes"."max_discount" is null)

promo_codes_gift_check.name: promo_codes_gift_check
promo_codes_gift_check.value: case when "promo_codes"."kind"::text = 'gift' then ("promo_codes"."gift_volume_id" is not null) <> "promo_codes"."gift_discovery_set" else "promo_codes"."gift_volume_id" is null and not "promo_codes"."gift_discovery_set" end

promo_codes_limits_check.name: promo_codes_limits_check
promo_codes_limits_check.value: coalesce("promo_codes"."max_discount", 1) > 0 and coalesce("promo_codes"."min_order_total", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("promo_codes"."total_limit", 1) > 0 and coalesce("promo_codes"."per_customer_limit", 1) > 0

staff_password_needs_login.name: staff_password_needs_login
staff_password_needs_login.value: "staff"."password_hash" is null or "staff"."login" is not null

staff_has_way_in.name: staff_has_way_in
staff_has_way_in.value: "staff"."telegram_id" is not null or "staff"."login" is not null

upgrade_rights_terms_check.name: upgrade_rights_terms_check
upgrade_rights_terms_check.value: "upgrade_rights"."percent" between 1 and 100 and "upgrade_rights"."expires_at" > "upgrade_rights"."opened_at" and jsonb_array_length("upgrade_rights"."fragrances") between 1 and 5 and "upgrade_rights"."source_unit" >= 0
